jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing Messaging
jobs.description:
About Eve

Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how  law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

About This Role:

You will own Eve's messaging house - the single source of truth for what Eve is, why it wins, and who it's for - and you will own the places that messaging actually gets tested: the first call deck, the keynote stage, and our customer stories.This is a role that makes sure every rep, every exec, and every event says the same differentiated thing, and that the thing itself is sharp enough to win.

What You Will Accomplish:

- Own the messaging house. Build and maintain the master messaging framework - core narrative, value pillars, proof points, persona messaging, and competitive counter-positioning.

- Own the first call deck. The highest-leverage asset in the company. You own its narrative, its structure, and its evolution, iterating against real deal outcomes

- Own our event session content. Own the narrative arc, script, and build of Eve's keynote and event sessions, partnering with the presenter (often an exec) from outline to stage, and in some cases presenting yourself.

- Partner with the executive team. Work directly with the CEO, CPO, and product leadership as the person who sharpens how they tell the Eve story — in board decks, on stage, on podcasts, and in the field. You'll push back on language that's vague, internal, or undifferentiated.

- Make sure we sound different. Build a defensible, well-sourced point of view on how Eve wins against the legal AI landscape, and make sure that difference is legible in every asset. If our messaging could be lifted onto a competitor's site without anyone noticing, that's your problem to fix.

- Ground it in the market. Talk to customers, prospects, and reps constantly. Bring what you hear back into the messaging and into Product.

- Make the messaging travel. Partner with Enablement, Demand Gen, Content, and the broader PMM team so the framework shows up accurately in collateral, campaigns, training, and launches.

What We Are Looking For:

7+ years in B2B SaaS or legal tech product marketing, with a track record of owning messaging and positioning for a core product or platform — not just contributing to it.An exceptional writer. You can take technical AI depth and turn it into something a busy plaintiff attorney understands in one pass. You care about the difference between a good sentence and a nearly-good one.Comfortable on stage and in front of executives. You can hold your own in a room with the CEO, and you can build a keynote that lands with a live audience.You think in frameworks — competitive messaging, category design, buyer psychology — and can explain not just what a product does, but why it wins.Genuinely curious about the market. You are willing to sit on ten sales calls and read analyst reports.A strong cross-functional partner who can hold one consistent story across Product, Sales, Events, and Marketing without becoming a bottleneck.

Nice to Have:
Legal AI experience

We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how  law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

What You'll Do:

- Own and deliver outsized results in a core product area or new 0→1 bet - Take full ownership of a major product surface or a new product initiative. You will drive adoption, retention, and expansion through exceptional execution, customer understanding, and high-quality product decisions.

- Help install scalable product practices - Implement lightweight, stage-appropriate product processes—bet reviews, PR/FAQs, design critiques—that make the team faster, sharper, and more aligned.

- Serve as a force multiplier for Product, Design, and Engineering - Raise the quality bar across the organization by modeling strong taste, sharp execution, and high standards. Empower designers and engineers to operate with ownership and clarity.

- Partner deeply with GTM to drive commercial success - Work closely with Sales, CS, and Marketing to shape pilots, craft compelling launch strategies, influence packaging and pricing, and support revenue-critical motions.

What We're Looking For:

- 4-8+ years experience directly owning entire product suites

- World-class product judgment & customer empathy - You’ve repeatedly turned complex enterprise workflows into simple, habit-forming products and know when to be opinionated versus configurable.

- End-to-end product ownership & proven 0→1 execution - A strong track record of leading (not just contributing to) products from discovery to launch to scale, operating with high autonomy and accountability.

- Enterprise B2B startup background with strong GTM partnership - Experience working hand-in-hand with Sales, CS, and Marketing on pricing, packaging, enablement, customer calls, pilots, and expansion.

- Operational excellence & decision quality - Crisp PRDs, sharp one-pagers, clean decision-making frameworks, and strong metric fluency. You bring clarity without relying on heavy process.

- Hands-on experience with applied LLMs and modern AI productization - Comfortable with LLM evals, retrieval/grounding, prompt-response workflows, human-in-the-loop systems, and knowing when model choice vs. UX vs. data earns the win.

- Cross-functional influence & high-quality communication - Earns trust, drives alignment, resolves conflict, and communicates clearly and convincingly in writing and reviews.

- High standards & team elevation - You raise the bar for product, design, and engineering quality through mentorship, taste, and exceptional execution.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience in legal tech or another complex, accuracy-sensitive vertical (financial services, healthcare, insurance).

- Familiarity with the plaintiff litigation lifecycle and case workflows.

- Prior experience in a PM-light environment where engineers and designers own large pieces of the product

- Exposure to packaging/pricing experimentation in high-growth SaaS

Eve will offer relocation assistance for candidates that are not based near that San Mateo area.
